description: This Dart source file defines an ApiService class providing methods to interact with a backend API, specifically to summarize content and save notes with a fallback mechanism when backend config is missing or requests fail.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A helper class to communicate with backend API for summarization and note saving, with fallback handling.

methods.name: ApiService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the API service, setting the base URL from environment variables.

methods.name: hasBackend
methods.description: Returns true if the backend URL is configured.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Attempts to generate a summary of provided content via backend API, throws if not available or on failure.

methods.name: saveNoteBestEffort
methods.description: Sends a note to backend for saving; errors are swallowed, allowing local fallback.
